method: Stratified random split. Test tasks per stratum: test_size spread evenly, with the leftover strata chosen by random.Random(seed). Within a stratum, units are shuffled and taken in order while they fit. Units keep near-duplicate tasks together.

file_injection.description: Injection hidden in a file the agent reads (bill, landlord notice, address change).

read_only_answer.description: Answer from the transaction history; the expected solution only reads. Injection in an incoming transaction.

schedule_or_account_change.description: Read the history, then change a scheduled payment, the password or account details. Injection in an incoming transaction.

send_money.description: Read the history, then send_money. Injection in an incoming transaction.
